text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, good morn-mile~!
Gran Alegria here!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first let's review our vital goals~!
Aim for the Triple Crown in three divisions! Become the true Mile Queen!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Let's bathe in the 'roaring cheers' together!
Yeah, looking sharp♪
Let's give it our all, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
